scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.rmSync('build',{recursive:true,force:true})" && npm run compile && npx tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && npx tsc-alias -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.lint: npm run lint:sol && npm run lint:js
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:sol:fix; npm run lint:js:fix
scripts.test:parallel: bash -c 'NODE_OPTIONS="--import tsx" npx hardhat test --parallel $(find test/contracts/integration test/scripts -name "*.test.ts")'
scripts.test:scripts:parallel: bash -c 'NODE_OPTIONS="--import tsx" npx hardhat test --no-compile --parallel $(find test/scripts -name "*.test.ts")'
scripts.test:scripts:coverage: bash -c 'NODE_OPTIONS="--import tsx" npx c8 npx hardhat test --no-compile $(find test/scripts -name "*.test.ts")'
scripts.test:scripts:unit:parallel: bash -c 'NODE_OPTIONS="--import tsx" npx hardhat test --no-compile --parallel $(find test/scripts/unit -name "*.test.ts")'
scripts.test:scripts:unit:coverage: bash -c 'NODE_OPTIONS="--import tsx" npx c8 npx hardhat test --no-compile $(find test/scripts/unit -name "*.test.ts")'
scripts.test:scripts:integration:parallel: bash -c 'NODE_OPTIONS="--import tsx" npx hardhat test --no-compile --parallel $(find test/scripts/integration -name "*.test.ts")'
scripts.test:scripts:integration:coverage: bash -c 'NODE_OPTIONS="--import tsx" npx c8 npx hardhat test --no-compile $(find test/scripts/integration -name "*.test.ts")'
scripts.slither: npm run slither:summary && npm run slither:storageLayout && npm run slither:inheritance && npm run slither:analysis
scripts.slither:analysis: docker run -t --rm -v /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock -v "$(pwd)":"/home/ethsec/contracts" -w "/home/ethsec/contracts" -u 0:0 trailofbits/eth-security-toolbox /bin/sh -c "solc-select install 0.8.18 && solc-select use 0.8.18 && slither . --solc-remaps @=node_modules/@"
scripts.slither:summary: docker run -t --rm -v /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock -v "$(pwd)":"/home/ethsec/contracts" -w "/home/ethsec/contracts" -u 0:0 trailofbits/eth-security-toolbox /bin/sh -c "solc-select install 0.8.18 && solc-select use 0.8.18 && slither . --print human-summary --solc-remaps @=node_modules/@"
scripts.slither:storageLayout: docker run -t --rm -v /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock -v "$(pwd)":"/home/ethsec/contracts" -w "/home/ethsec/contracts" -u 0:0 trailofbits/eth-security-toolbox /bin/sh -c "solc-select install 0.8.18 && solc-select use 0.8.18 && slither . --print variable-order --solc-remaps @=node_modules/@"
scripts.slither:inheritance: docker run -t --rm -v /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock -v "$(pwd)":"/home/ethsec/contracts" -w "/home/ethsec/contracts" -u 0:0 trailofbits/eth-security-toolbox /bin/sh -c "solc-select install 0.8.18 && solc-select use 0.8.18 && slither . --print inheritance --solc-remaps @=node_modules/@"
scripts.validate:package: npm run build && npx publint && npx @arethetypeswrong/cli --pack
scripts.ignition:deploy:local: npx hardhat ignition deploy ignition/modules/AtsSystem.ts --network local --deployment-id ats-local
scripts.ignition:deploy:hedera:testnet: npx hardhat ignition deploy ignition/modules/AtsSystem.ts --network hedera-testnet --deployment-id ats-hedera-testnet
scripts.ignition:deploy:besu: npx hardhat ignition deploy ignition/modules/AtsSystem.ts --network besu-iob --deployment-id besu-iob
scripts.ignition:deploy:hedera:mainnet: npx hardhat ignition deploy ignition/modules/AtsSystem.ts --network hedera-mainnet --deployment-id ats-hedera-mainnet
scripts.ignition:deploy:timetravel:local: npx hardhat ignition deploy ignition/modules/AtsTimeTravelSystem.ts --network local --deployment-id ats-tt-local
